name: Adaptive
body:
You quickly become accustomed to a given environment during your interstellar travels.

Prerequisite(s): Base Fortitude save +3, base Reflex save +3.

Benefit(s): You gain a +4 bonus on saving throws or ability checks against environmental hazards. This includes (but is not limited to) earthquakes, cold or heat, starvation and thirst, suffocation, wind, or weather.
